name: Rep. Ted Lieu Youth Advisory Council
org: Office of U.S. Representative Ted Lieu
city: Los Angeles County, CA (Rep. Lieu's district)
what_you_do: Talk about issues with other students. Suggest bills for the Congressman to support. Work with his staff on issues that matter to young people in the district.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 9 to 12 who live or go to school in Rep. Lieu's district. Incoming 9th graders can apply with 8th grade transcripts.
pay_detail: The page does not mention pay
duration: One-year term, up to two years. Eight meetings a year.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-2027 are closed. Dates for the next cycle are not posted as of Nov 3, 2026.
how_to_apply: Send it all at one time: transcript, two letters from people not in your family, a one-page essay, a resume and a signed consent form. If it is complete, you get a 15-minute interview.
notes: You must attend 6 of 8 meetings. The page names two different district numbers and does not list cities. Ask if you are in the district: yac.lieu@mail.house.gov or (323) 651-1040.
